release.photography: Representative photographs are reused; no claim of step-specific photos.
release.curriculum: Educational subdivisions and route branches, not a qualified manufacturing traveler.
release.demoScope: Teaching animations derived from exercise models; not a manufacturing digital twin.
release.narrationScope: Native device speech; two authored core languages; other languages need configured translation and a matching installed voice. Text guidance is always available.
release.videoScope: A separate public HTTPS player removes academy/ChatGPT authentication from file-mode playback. YouTube, publisher, network and browser restrictions still apply.
release.researchScope: Discipline-specific research worksheets; not authored manufacturing instructions.
release.catalogScope: Curated representative topics, not a verified global top-500/top-1000 ranking; includes historical antecedents predating the last century.
release.projectVisualScope: Original subject architectures: 99 semiconductor, 100 packaging/photonics, 100 electrical/electronics, 100 computing/security and 80 named world projects. Diagrams are educational, not CAD. Licensed photographs are representative; V11 adds diagrams and preserves V10 photographs/videos.
release.sourceVisibility: User-provided course-material index removed from the released site and offline data.
release.comparisonScope: Each guided course has authored comparisons and representative map points. Repeated institutions are not distinct fabrication sites.
release.aiRoutesScope: Browser CPU text; optional native CPU text/vision and server-side Gemini text/image with explicit per-request cloud consent. No weights or private keys bundled.
release.aiScope: Optional consent-based local CPU generation; models download separately. Cloud accounts require Supabase configuration; local profiles work without it.
release.billingScope: Hosted owner/demo and offline editions contain complete source; protected Python HTTPS commerce requires operator configuration. No live payment activated.
release.languageScope: Traditional Chinese and English core; 77 optional machine-translated languages require a configured service. Voice availability depends on the device.
release.computingScope: 100 focused computing/security curricula plus named quantum, acceleration, energy and resource systems. Original architectural exercises and synthetic local evidence, not deployment or industrial operating manuals.
release.opticsScope: 101 optics and precision-instrument curricula (99 new, asml and a405 extended): 8 authored units per course, each expanded into mechanism, quantitative, verification and failure-diagnosis steps. Original teaching exercises, not vendor recipes or operating procedures.
release.marketData: Weekly delayed snapshot (tools/markets-v12/update_markets.py, GitHub Action weekly-markets.yml); live TradingView chart on request.
release.structuresScope: 100 bridges-and-buildings curricula (96 new, danjiang, b003, b015 and b021 extended): 10 authored units per course, each expanded into load-path, quantitative, testing and failure-diagnosis steps, plus a dossier of key figures, timeline, codes and landmark comparisons. Original teaching exercises, not design documents, method statements or work permits.
